gates.exact_gap_or_note: Proved reduction: the triangle-free colour H has max degree below n, since a neighbourhood is a clique in the other colour. Splitting into blocks of size s, only complete block pairs obstruct, giving a bipartite graph D on [L]x[L] of degree at most 2m/s. Exact unpaid lemma: there are c,C>0 such that for every permutation pi of [m] and every bipartite D on [Cm]x[Cm] of maximum degree at most m^c there are increasing p,q:[m]->[Cm] with (p(i),q(pi(i))) not in D. This would give r=O(n^(2-c)). Tried: independent windows fail on pi-aligned complete cells; a bi-hole handles only degree O(1); first moment handles only unstructured D; repair by shifting blocks is uncontrolled for blow-ups of expanders.
